points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for clinical document intelligence, improving answer reliability by ~20% and enabling AI-powered precision in clinical trial data analysis.

\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings with BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage for clinical data extraction and enabling faster, more robust analysis of patient information.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of clinical QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability and rigorous validation for healthcare applications.

\item Optimized data processing through batched query extraction, reducing computational overhead by ~80% and enabling faster, reliable clinical trial analysis with AI-powered decision support systems.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for clinical workflows, reducing data quality issues by 25% while maintaining regulatory compliance and improving operational efficiency in clinical development.
